question: A gallon of paint is used to paint a room. One third of the paint is used on the first day. On the second day, one third of the remaining paint is used. What fraction of the original amount of paint is available to use on the third day?
solution:
Using one third of an amount leaves \(1-\frac13=\frac23\) of that amount. After the first day, \(\frac23\) of the original paint remains. The second day leaves \(\frac23\) of this remaining paint, so the fraction of the original amount available on the third day is
\[
\frac23\cdot\frac23=\boxed{\frac49},
\]
choice \(\text{D}\).
